name: Love Blossoms Anew
source:
It’s Valentine’s Day, and you’re excited! 

…Until something happens that turns your excitement into dread, thus leading you to meet a [i]very[/i] interesting individual. With no other choice but to go with the flow, you’re swept into an unintentional adventure! 

[From [url=https://himebee.itch.io/love-blossoms-anew]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今天是情人节，你满心雀跃！

……直到一场突发变故将你的兴奋化作了惶恐，也让你阴差阳错地邂逅了一位[i]格外[/i]有趣的人物。别无选择的你只能顺水推舟，就此被卷入了一场始料未及的奇妙冒险！

[摘自[url=https://himebee.itch.io/love-blossoms-anew]itch.io[/url]]
